messages:
anna: Uploaded a screenshot of the compact credentials list — trying a chip-first interaction where each key shows as a compact pill with copy + overflow. thinking about: keyboard targets, SR behavior, and how warnings surface when you rotate/revoke.

raj: Nice! Quick q — what's the primary click target on the chip? copy secret or open actions? need to avoid accidental reveal when tabbing.

anna: Primary click currently copies the key; overflow (3-dot) opens actions (rotate/revoke). keyboard: `Enter` on chip = copy, `Space` opens overflow. open to flipping.

maria: Tone nudge: revoke confirmation reads pretty heavy. can we soften to "This will stop usage immediately. You can restore within 5 minutes." then show deeper warning for revoking production tokens?

design-bot: Suggestion: make copy explicit with a small visible copy icon inside the chip. That reduces accidental reveal. Also attach `aria-describedby` to the chip for status messages.

lisa: FWIW screen reader behavior: if copy triggers a transient toast that contains the secret text, SR will announce the whole secret. we should never dump raw secret into an aria-live region. instead announce "Key copied to clipboard" and persist secret only in an ephemeral dialog that is focus-managed.

raj: Agreed. SR approach: 1) on copy -> announce "Key copied" (aria-live polite). 2) if user requests reveal -> open modal with role=dialog, focus trap, and explicit "Show secret" button. only reveal after a second confirmation.

anna: Good call. Also thinking about rotate UX: currently rotate is modal-heavy. perf teams worry about accidental rotates during bursts of activity. maybe a two-step inline flow: click rotate -> inline status row "Preparing rotation" -> then confirm rotate in modal?

tom: Inline status could be weird for mobile. If inline row appears, ensure it doesn't shift layout or push pagination. consider an inline skeleton with fixed height.

maria: Copy copy change for revoke button: current label "Revoke" -> propose "Revoke (permanently stop)" is too scary. propose "Disable key" with a secondary "Permanently delete" in advanced actions.

anna: Love "Disable" approach. Allows soft-delete + undo toast. Speaking of undo: toast should include keyboard focusable "Undo" and ARIA role=alert so SR users notice it. but again, do not put key text in the alert.

design-bot: Accessibility nit: focus order when overflow menu opens — menu should get focus on open, and first item should be keyboard-navigable. add `aria-haspopup=\"true\"` on overflow button.

oliver: Quick implementation detail: for the copy icon inside the chip, use a 24px touch target but visually smaller. interplay with compact mode: chips wrap; ensure overflow menu remains at end of row.

lisa: Also add screen-reader-only text for private builds: when a key has been rotated and the old token is still valid for a grace period, announce status as "Previously rotated — active until <time>" instead of showing epoch. keep it human.

raj: Edge-case: bulk revoke while some items are already in a rotating state -> we need clear conflict messaging. propose modal that lists conflict rows and uses checkboxes to confirm per-key action.

anna: UX ask: can we show a tiny inline affordance for permission scopes on the chip? eg a subtle lock icon with tooltip that shows scopes on hover. helps surface which keys are wide-scope.

maria: Tooltip copy suggestion: rather than dumping JSON of scopes, show a friendly summary: "Read: buckets, Write: models" and link to role details.

tom: Performance ask: avoid live querying of scopes for every chip render. cache per-page and lazy-load detail on hover or focus.

design-bot: Microcopy suggestion for empty-state when no keys: "You don't have any API tokens yet. Create one to start using Redwood in your apps." Provide a primary CTA: "Create token" and a secondary: "Learn about scopes". also include keyboard shortcut hint for power users (press C).

anna: One more a11y detail: reveal secret button should have `aria-pressed` toggling and change label to "Hide secret" when revealed. plus an SR-only line: "Secret will be visible on screen" before reveal.

oliver: Implementation plan looks clear. I'll add unit tests for aria attributes and a small e2e for keyboard flows. also add telemetry for copy/rotate/revoke events (no secret included).

maria: QA checklist: keyboard nav, SR announcements, focus after modal close, toast undo timing (5s default), bulk revoke conflict handling, tooltip truncation, copy icon visibility in high-contrast.

anna: Thanks everyone — action items: @oliver impl keyboard+aria tests, @lisa write SR guidance snippets for copy/announce, @maria update microcopy options, @design-bot provide updated comps with chip icon and inline skeleton. I'll follow up with a prototype tomorrow. :thumbsup:
